trends.name: US-Iran Military Escalation & Oil
trends.summary: Trump threatens imminent strikes on Iranian power plants if Strait of Hormuz isn't reopened within 48 hours, while Iran retaliates with missile strikes and threats of 'surprising' responses. Brent crude surges above $110, creating immediate stagflation concerns as energy costs feed into inflation expectations (CPI forecast 3.98% YoY per Kalshi markets). Regional escalation risk is highest since Trump's negotiations team now seeks Qatar mediation.

trends.name: Energy Crisis Driving Market Volatility
trends.summary: Goldman Sachs macro traders warn 'Energy is driving everything' as central banks missed opportunity to calm markets. Oil's omnipresence across industrial production, chemicals, and plastics means expensive energy creates systemic inflation beyond fuel prices. Current elevated oil levels pose growth risks if they persist, potentially forcing policy responses despite limited ECB visibility.

trends.name: Four-Week Stock Market Decline
trends.summary: Stocks have fallen for a 4th consecutive week as three dominant themes gripped Wall Street. Confluence of geopolitical tensions, energy price shocks, and macro uncertainty is creating sustained selling pressure across equities with limited fundamental offset.

trends.name: AI Commoditization Concerns
trends.summary: OpenClaw's ChatGPT moment sparks investor concern that large language models and AI tools are rapidly becoming commoditized, threatening margin expansion for early movers. This echoes broader fears about generative AI ROI as competition intensifies and differentiation erodes. Contrasts with JPMorgan Dimon's longer-term optimism on AI productivity gains.

trends.name: Dividend & Value Yields Attracting Capital
trends.summary: Market-ignored value stocks now offer 7-13% yields attracting income-focused investors seeking inflation hedges. Themes include Sunstone Hotel preferred stock yields, dividend replacement strategies, and managed futures ETFs capitalizing on volatility. Retail investors increasingly replacing salaries with portfolio income amid equity volatility.

trends.name: Government Shutdown & DHS Funding Crisis
trends.summary: Trump threatens Monday ICE deployment at airports over DHS shutdown standoff, while Elon Musk offers to cover TSA agent pay to resolve impasse. Immediate operational risk to air travel and commerce if unresolved; signals political dysfunction affecting market confidence and business operations.

trends.name: Bitcoin Adoption by Financial Advisers
trends.summary: Wealth advisers shifting from outright rejection to conditional Bitcoin allocation as institutional acceptance grows. However, adoption includes strict guardrails and allocation caps, reflecting ongoing debate over crypto's role in diversified portfolios amid macro uncertainty.

trends.name: Stagflation Hedges & Asset Classes
trends.summary: Market attention turning to overlooked asset classes historically resilient against 1970s-style stagflation scenarios. Rising inflation expectations and energy shocks prompt investors to revisit commodities, real assets, and alternative income strategies as traditional equity-bond diversification faces simultaneous pressure.

trends.name: Retail Tech M&A: Walmart Digital Price Labels
trends.summary: Walmart rolling out digital price labels to every U.S. store shelf by end-2026, signaling major retail modernization and cost optimization push. Technology deployment affects competitive dynamics, labor needs, and supply chain efficiency across retail sector.

trends.name: SCHD ETF March 2026 Reconstitution
trends.summary: Major Schwab dividend ETF reconstitution in March 2026 reshuffling holdings and potentially triggering sector rotation flows. Dividend-focused funds experiencing capital shifts as index changes filter through passive and active accounts tracking yield strategies.

trends.name: Tax Policy Changes 2026 & Retirement Planning
trends.summary: IRS announces 2026 tax rule changes affecting retirement savings, IRA management, and benefit optimization. Investor focus on Social Security timing, annuity structures, and tax-loss harvesting as new regulations reshape retirement income strategy landscape.

trends.name: Betting Scandals Threaten $165B Gaming Market
trends.summary: Pro sports betting scandals creating regulatory and reputational risk to the $165 billion gaming and sports betting market. Integrity concerns may trigger stricter oversight, affecting growth trajectory for gambling operators and sports leagues reliant on betting revenue.
